the maximum principle for Lp-viscous solutions of fully nonlinear PDE with measurable terms can be obtained without any additional assumptions on the nonlinearity.
the Lp-regularity of the solutions is not required in our approach, which is in sharp contrast to the classical approach of Evans-Krylov type.
